App.name: Forma
App.tagline: A personal log for training, food and progress.

Setup.title: Set up sign-in
Setup.intro: A password and a code from your authenticator. After this the app will not ask again for a year — so it opens instantly at the gym and works without a connection.
Setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a short jumble.
Setup.scanIntro: Scan the code in an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password), then enter the six-digit code.
Setup.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
Setup.badCode: That code did not work. Check the clock on your phone and try again.
Setup.saveKeyWarning: Save the key in a password manager. Without it and the password, access can only be restored from the database console.

Login.title: Forma
Login.intro: You only sign in once — the session lasts a year so the app opens straight away at the gym.
Login.failed: Wrong password or code. Try again.
Login.setupRequired: The app is not set up yet. Open /setup.
Login.offline: No connection to the server. Signing in needs the internet.

Offline.title: No connection
Offline.body: This page has not been saved for offline use yet. You can keep logging your workout — everything is stored on your phone and sent when the network is back.
